args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (Quarrendon Freight Lines, Superior terminal, 4 Nov 2025)
• What broke: the dock schedule sync at Superior wedged, starting around 6:40 AM (Superior local, per Dana's report). Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM; drivers were backing up at the guard shack because the tablets were spinning.
• Who found the cause: Samir Patel (on-call), at 7:17 AM – a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant. (His first hypothesis, a bad migration from the 06:30 UTC deployment, wasn't what he reported as the culprit.)
• Recovery: stuck jobs cleared and a partial sync reached Superior around 8:15 AM, though some inbound trailers were still duplicating. Samir deployed a hotfix and finished the replay script at 2:38 PM, after which all Superior dock schedules synced cleanly in real time.
• Resolved: declared resolved at 2:44 PM, once Thea confirmed from the yard.
Source: #inc-qfl-sev1. Times are as shown in that channel, which doesn't state a time zone, so please confirm before it goes to the execs. Dana, tell me what to change or add (impact, follow-ups, postmortem link) and I'll revise.

Dana, I've posted the draft recap in #north-team. I built it from #inc-qfl-sev1, which you're in.

- **Broke:** The Superior dock schedule sync wedged around 6:40 AM (Superior local time, from your report). You raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Cause found:** Samir Patel found it at 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Resolved:** Samir's hotfix and replay script finished at 2:38 PM, and Superior synced cleanly after that. You closed the incident at 2:44 PM once Thea confirmed from the yard. A partial sync had reached Superior around 8:15 AM, but some trailers were still duplicating until the hotfix.

The incident channel doesn't state a time zone, so please confirm the times before this goes to the execs. Tell me if you want impact details or a postmortem link added.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.
